intro
Bursar is a treasury agent for companies, built on Blaaiz.
Bursar is a treasury agent for companies, built on Blaze.
line
Small bills sit under your line, so Bursar pays them alone. Big ones sink the line and wait for you.
Small bills sit under your line, so Bursar pays them alone. Big ones sink the line, and wait for you.
how
It forecasts every wallet, pays bills when they're due, and asks you before any swap or anything over your line.
It forecasts every wallet, pays bills when they're due, and asks you before any swap, or anything over your line.
rules2
Every payment is checked against your rules twice before Blaaiz is called. No AI model can approve money.
Every payment is checked against your rules twice, before Blaze is called. No A.I. model can approve money.
